posts.title: DHS Plans $100M+ Follow-On OneStream Systems Integrator BPA
posts.summary: DHS plans to compete a $100M+ follow-on BPA for a systems integrator to operate and maintain its OneStream platform, with solicitation expected Oct 20, 2026 and award in Q2 FY2027.

posts.title: Splash 2026: SensibleAI Agents Go GA and Finance Gets an Agentic Layer
posts.summary: At Splash 2026, OneStream announced GA of its four SensibleAI Agents (Search, Finance Analyst, Deep Analysis, Forecast) and a Finance Agentic Layer connecting Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini to governed platform data.

posts.title: OneStream Completes Its $6.4B Acquisition by Hg
posts.summary: OneStream completed its all-cash go-private acquisition by Hg on April 1, 2026, valuing the company at about $6.4 billion; General Atlantic and Tidemark are minority investors and Tom Shea remains CEO.

posts.title: OneStream Named a 4x Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant
posts.summary: OneStream was named a Leader for the fourth consecutive year in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Financial Close and Consolidation Solutions, placed furthest in Completeness of Vision among 14 vendors; the same week it announced Splash 2026 (May 18-20, Orlando) and the OneStream World Tour.
